outcomeNote: a baraita expounding the verse in support of the mishna

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: אִילּוּ נֶאֱמַר ״מִנְחָה מַחֲצִית״, הָיִיתִי אוֹמֵר מֵבִיא חֲצִי עִשָּׂרוֹן מִבֵּיתוֹ שַׁחֲרִית וּמַקְרִיב, חֲצִי עִשָּׂרוֹן מִבֵּיתוֹ עַרְבִית וּמַקְרִיב.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The Gemara cites that which «the Sages taught» in a baraita, commenting on the verse: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the Lord on the day when he is anointed: The tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening” (Leviticus 6:13). «If» the verse had «stated: A meal offering» perpetually, «half» in the morning and half in the evening; «I would have said» that the High Priest «brings half of a tenth» of an ephah «in the morning and sacrifices» it, and then he brings «half of a tenth» of an ephah «in the afternoon and sacrifices» it.

segments.he: תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר ״מַחֲצִיתָהּ בַּבֹּקֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָהּ בָּעָרֶב״ – מֶחֱצָה מִשָּׁלֵם הוּא מַקְרִיב, הָא כֵּיצַד? מֵבִיא עִשָּׂרוֹן שָׁלֵם וְחוֹצֵהוּ, וּמַקְרִיב מֶחֱצָה בַּבֹּקֶר וּמֶחֱצָה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם.
segments.en: Since «the verse states: “Half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening”» (Leviticus 6:13), it teaches that «he sacrifices half of a complete» tenth of an ephah. «How so?» The High Priest «brings» from his house «a complete tenth» of an ephah of fine flour, «and divides it» in half, «and sacrifices half in the morning and half in the afternoon.»

segments.he: נִטְמָא מֶחֱצָה שֶׁל בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם, אוֹ שֶׁאָבַד, יָכוֹל יָבִיא חֲצִי עִשָּׂרוֹן מִבֵּיתוֹ עַרְבִית וְיַקְרִיב? תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר ״מַחֲצִיתָהּ בַּבֹּקֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָהּ בָּעָרֶב״ – מֶחֱצָה מִשָּׁלֵם הוּא מֵבִיא.
segments.en: In a case where the «half of» a tenth of an ephah that was supposed to be offered in «the afternoon became impure or was lost» after the High Priest sacrificed the first half in the morning, one «might» have thought that «he should bring half of a tenth» of an ephah «from his house and sacrifice» it. Therefore, «the verse states: “Half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening,”» which teaches that «he brings half of a complete» tenth of an ephah.

segments.he: הָא כֵּיצַד? מֵבִיא עִשָּׂרוֹן שָׁלֵם [מִבֵּיתוֹ], וְחוֹצֵהוּ, וּמַקְרִיב מֶחֱצָה, וּמֶחֱצָה אָבֵד. נִמְצְאוּ שְׁנֵי חֲצָאִין קְרֵיבִין, וּשְׁנֵי חֲצָאִין אוֹבְדִין.
segments.en: «How so?» The High Priest «brings a complete tenth» of an ephah of fine flour «from his house and divides it» in half, «and he sacrifices half, and» the other «half» is not sacrificed and «is lost. Consequently, two halves» of a tenth of an ephah «are sacrificed,» the half that was sacrificed in the morning from the original tenth of an ephah, and half of the replacement tenth of an ephah, «and» the other «two halves are lost.»

segments.he: כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל שֶׁהִקְרִיב מֶחֱצָה שַׁחֲרִית וָמֵת, וּמִינּוּ אַחֵר תַּחְתָּיו, יָכוֹל יָבִיא חֲצִי עִשָּׂרוֹן מִבֵּיתוֹ, אוֹ חֲצִי עֶשְׂרוֹנוֹ שֶׁל רִאשׁוֹן? תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר ״וּמַחֲצִיתָהּ בָּעָרֶב״ – מֶחֱצָה מִשָּׁלֵם הוּא מֵבִיא וּמַקְרִיב.
segments.en: In the case of a High «Priest who sacrificed half in the morning and died, and they appointed another» High «Priest in his stead,» one «might» have thought that the second High Priest «should bring half of a tenth» of an ephah «from his house» and sacrifice it, «or» that he should sacrifice the remaining «half of a tenth» of an ephah «of the first» High Priest. Therefore, «the verse states: “And half of it in the evening,”» which teaches that he «brings and sacrifices half of a complete» tenth of an ephah.

segments.he: הָא כֵּיצַד? מֵבִיא עִשָּׂרוֹן שָׁלֵם, וְחוֹצֵהוּ, וּמַקְרִיב, וּמֶחֱצָה אָבֵד. נִמְצְאוּ שְׁנֵי חֲצָאִין אוֹבְדִין, וּשְׁנֵי חֲצָאִין קְרֵיבִין.
segments.en: «How so?» The replacement High Priest «brings a complete tenth» of an ephah of fine flour «from his house and divides it» in half, «and he sacrifices» half, «and half» is not sacrificed and «is lost. Consequently, two halves» of a tenth of an ephah «are lost,» half of the tenth of an ephah brought by each priest, «and» the other «two halves are sacrificed.»

edges.about: a baraita expounding 'half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening'
the baraita supplies the scriptural basis for the mishna's rule that a whole tenth is brought and halved
'half of it' (with the suffix) teaches half of a complete tenth, not half-tenths brought separately
if the afternoon half became impure or lost, a new whole tenth is brought and halved
a replacement High Priest brings a new whole tenth, neither a half-tenth from home nor his predecessor's half

positions.claim: each half offered must be half of a complete tenth; a new whole tenth is brought and halved when a half is lost or the High Priest dies
